system.description:
You focus your lightning chakra, forming it into the shape of a land animal of your choice such as a Bear, a Panther, or Wolf. The Lightning Beast has the listed statistics found on its stat block in the Summon Stat Blocks section.

You may command the Lightning Beast as a bonus action on your turn. The Lightning Beast may take an appropriate reaction if able, such as attack of opportunity. The Lightning Beast uses your Ninjutsu Attack bonus for its attacks and your Save DC for all of its effects save DC’s.

At Higher Ranks: For each rank you cast this jutsu above B-Rank, increase the cost of this jutsu by 3.
